scientific_integrity.central_claim: For every clique order of at least three and cycle order of at least five, a complete labeled maximum-open-packing census in three residue classes and a determinant-derived generating function for every cardinality.
limitations: The maximum packing cardinality alone is already implied by the previously published general graph-product theorem and is not claimed as new.
No extension is claimed at clique size two or cycle length below five.
Literature searches cannot exclude every unindexed cyclic-word formula or computational table; independent assessment not performed.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Proof, three distinct verification programs, and their observed output logs embedded.

title: Exact optimal open-packing census and generating series for cyclic clique cylinders
